# Erik Olsson - Personal Website

> A personal portfolio and website built with Astro.

## Identity & Purpose
Created by Erik Olsson as a professional portfolio and digital hub.

## Pages
- [Home](https://mangila.github.io/): Overview of Erik's GitHub README
- [Guides](https://mangila.github.io/guides): Overview of Erik's GitHub Gists
- [Projects](https://mangila.github.io/projects): Overview of Erik's GitHub repositories

## Technical Stack
- **Framework**: Astro (Static Site Generation)
- **Deployment**: GitHub Pages
- **Performance**: Optimized for near-instant load times and high Lighthouse scores.

## Social & Links
- [GitHub](https://github.com/mangila): View the source code and other projects.
